name: Sub-conductor — a conductor that conducts conductors
description: The lead conductor spawns one or more sub-conductors, each conducting its own scope — one level deep.

sub-conductor.description: Use only when the user asks for nested conductors; this playbook is the sanctioned way for a conductor to conduct conductors. You are the lead conductor, and each session spawned here is a sub-conductor under you. Spawn one, or several in one turn — one per project or independent effort. Open each brief with that relationship: it is a sub-conductor reporting to you, the lead conductor. Then state: the project(s) it conducts and nothing else; whether it may merge, or hands each worktree back with `READY_TO_LAND <worktree>` for you to land; that it never spawns a conductor itself — this playbook is the lead conductor's, not its; that it drives only sessions it spawned, never a sibling; that its wiki writes stay under its projects' `projects/<name>/`; and that hard calls come back to you via `AskUserQuestion`.
